articles.title: Solana ETFs extend growth streak to 5 days after year's biggest inflows
articles.snippet: Monday's $33.5 million was the largest single-day inflow since December, pushing cumulative net inflows to a record $1.22 billion and trading volume to $166.8 million.

articles.title: Franklin Templeton and Hashkey roll out U.S. tokenized money fund in Asia
articles.snippet: Tokenized U.S. treasury and money market funds are one of the fastest-growing segments in the digital asset markets, growing fifteenfold in two years.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin settles in under $80,000, with interest rates headed lower on Tuesday
articles.snippet: Spot bitcoin funds took in $337.56 million on Aug. 24, extending an unbroken run of inflows that has now put real money behind a rally that started with a short squeeze.

articles.title: Monad proposes wallet upgrade that could survive lost keys and quantum attacks
articles.snippet: The Ethereum-compatible blockchain wants users to be able to replace the keys controlling an account without changing its address, opening the door to passkeys, recovery tools and post-quantum security.

articles.title: Standard Chartered becomes first bank distributor of HKD stablecoin
articles.snippet: The bank plans tokenized money market fund settlements in the fourth quarter as HKDAP expands its phased rollout into conventional banking.
